newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria sells plaster maker to KNAUF GmbH-Austria.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria sells plaster maker to KNAUF GmbH-Austria.

text.p: Bulgaria's Privatisation Agency said on Friday it had sold 60 percent of Gipsfazer plaster and thermal isolation construction materials maker to KNAUF GmbH - Austria for $5.7 million.

Under the contract the buyer has to pay $4.6 million cash and repay also in cash a $1.1 million Gipsfazer debt to Bulgaria's private Bank for Agricultural Credit (BAC), the agency said in a statement.
The buyer also pledged to invest $5.405 million in Gipsfazer over the next five years.
KNAUF GmbH-Austria is 100 percent owned by Germany's KNAUF group, a producer of construction materials with an annual turnover of some four billion German marks, the statement said.
Vidin-based Gipsfazer produces gypsum thermal isolation panels for walls and floors and suspension ceilings for house construction.

Of the remaining 40 percent equity, 25 percent will be offered for voucher privatisation under Bulgaria's mass sell-off programme and the remaining 15 percent will be offered to Gipsfazer employees at preferential prices.
